description: Victorian Water Supply Protection Areas is a dataset listed in Australian Government open data portal (data.gov.au), an open data portal, published or maintained by Bioregional Assessment Program. Abstract This dataset and its metadata statement were supplied to the Bioregional Assessment Programme by a third part and are presented here as originally supplied. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Bioregional Assessment Program. Its tags are Gippsland Basin bioregion, Victoria, environment, inlandWaters. It offers 1 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2022-04-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
